summary: Wrote the standalone homily for the Seventeenth Sunday after Pentecost from the two accepted studies: homily.tex and its two declared components, a 1,406-word spoken body (10.8-11.7 minutes at 120-130 words a minute) preaching the Gospel's two questions joined as Chrysostom joins them, with the Epistle's unity and the Collect that asks for what the Gospel commands, and a terminal note with the audience, word count, pace estimate, relation to the three reviewed readings, English routes, exact loci and References. The 5-page proof settles in two passes with a clean log and passes every homily-gate check; the shared generation timestamp was updated and both studies rebuilt unchanged at 38 and 12 pages.
